mapper.select: select * from outbox_event where status in ('PENDING','RETRY') and next_attempt_at<=#{now} order by next_attempt_at,id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update outbox_event set status='PUBLISHED',published_at=#{publishedAt},last_error=null,update_time=#{updateTime} where id=#{id} and status in ('PENDING','RETRY')
